verses.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.sm: Solomona le atalii o Tavita, le tupu o Isaraelu;

verses.en: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.sm: ina ia iloa ai le poto ma ia aʻoaʻoina; ia lagona ai upu e atamai ai;

verses.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.sm: ia maua ai le aʻoaʻoina i le poto, ma le amiotonu, ma le faamasinoga, ma le amio sa'o;

verses.en: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.sm: ia avatu ai le faautauta i e faigofie; o le poto ma le mafaufau i le taulealea.

verses.en: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.sm: E faalogo mai le tagata poto, E tupu ai pea lona poto; o le ua mafaufau foi e maua e ia le poto e pule ai;

verses.en: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.sm: e lagona ai le faataoto ma lona faamatalaga; o upu a e popoto ma a latou upu lilo.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.sm: O le mataʻu i le Aw, o le amataga lea o le poto; a e ‘ino‘ino tagata valelea i le poto ma le a‘oa‘oina.

verses.en: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.sm: Lo‘u atalii e, faalogo mai ia i le aʻoaʻo atu a lou tama; aua foi e te tuulafoaiina le upu a lou tina;

verses.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.sm: aua e ѓa: ia mea ma pale matagofie i lou ulu, ma mea e asoa i lou ua.

verses.en: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.sm: Lo‘u atalii e, afai e faaoleole ia te oe tagata agasala, aua ne‘i e usiusitai i ai;

verses.en: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.sm: afai latou te fai mai, Tatou o; tatou te lamalama i le toto, ia tatou talialaina le ua fai fua lana amio lelei;

verses.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.sm: tatou te foloolaina i latou, e pei o le tuugamau; ia atoatoa lava e pei o e o ifo i le lua.

verses.en: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.sm: Tatou te maua ai oloa táua uma lava; tatou te faatutumu o tatou fale i le vete;

verses.en: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.sm: tatou te fai faatasi la tatou vili; ia tasi se taga tupe ia te i tatou uma.

verses.en: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.sm: Lou atalii e, aua tou te o i le ala faátasi ma i latou; taofi ia ou vae neʻi ui i lo latou ala;

verses.en: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.sm: Aua ua taufetuli o latou vae i le leaga, ma faataalise e sasaa ai le toto.

verses.en: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.sm: Aua e vae fua le upega a ua iloa e le manu lele.

verses.en: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.sm: A o i latou ua lamalama i latou i o latou lava toto; ua latou talialaina i latou ia i latou lava ia oti.

verses.en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.sm: E faapena ala o i latou uma o e matapeapea i le oloa; e aveeseina ai le ola o e ua iai.

verses.en: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.sm: O loo alaga le poto i fafo; ua leo tele i malae.

verses.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
verses.sm: Ua valaau o ia i le mea e sili ona taalili ai o tagata, o faitotoa o le aai; ua fai atu ana upu i le aai;

verses.en: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.sm: o outou E faigofie, tou te loto i le amio faigofie seia afea? ma e tauemu, latou te fiafia i le tauemuga seia afea? ma e valelea, latou te ‘ino‘inò i le poto seia afea?

verses.en: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.sm: Liliu mai ia i laʻu aoaiga; faauta, ou te liligi atu loʻu Agaga ia te outou; ou te faailoa atu aʻu upu ia te outou.

verses.en: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.sm: Na ou valaau, a e lei mafafai outou; na ou faaloaloa lo‘u lima, a E leai se na faalogo mai;

verses.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.sm: na outou teena laʻu pule uma lava, ma outou le mafafai i la‘u aoaiga;

verses.en: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.sm: o le mea lea, ou te “ata ai au i lo outou malaia; ou te tauemu pe a 00 mai lo outou fefe;

verses.en: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.sm: pe a 00 mai lo outou fefe pei se afa, pe a oo mai foi lo outou malaia pei se asiosio; pe a 00 mai ia te outou le puapuaga ma le atuatuvale.

verses.en: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.sm: Ona latou valaau mai ai lea ia te au, a o aʻu, ou te le tali atu ai; latou te sailiili mai ia te au, a e latou te le maua aʻu.

verses.en: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.sm: Na latou “ino'ino i le poto; ua latou le manao foi i le mataʻu i le ALII;

verses.en: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.sm: na latou le mafafai i laʻu pule; ua latou ʻinoʻino i laʻu aoaiga uma lava;

verses.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.sm: o le mea lava lea latou te aai ai i le fua oa latou amio; e maoona foi i latou i a latou togafiti.

verses.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.sm: Aua o le liliu ese o e faigofie e fasiotia ai i latou; o le nofo faatalanoa o e valelea e fano ai i latou.

verses.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.sm: A o lē faalogo mai ia te au, e nofo o ia ma le fifilemu; e filemu o ia, e le fefe i se mea leaga.
